notes.title: The Future Of Nightfall
notes.notes:
Sorry it took me so long to get this out but for the moment i will not be updating Nightfall. This doesn't mean it wont get updated but at least for the moment there will be nothing new. I may come back to Nightfall at a later point and if i do i will announce it.

Thanks 

Sincerely Split World Studios

notes.title: Shop and Roadmap Change
notes.notes:
The Shopkeeper can be found in the area after the boss. You can sell and buy items from the shopkeeper. 

Added:

[list]
[*] added the shop
[/list]

Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where after returning to the first area you are teleported out of bounds.
Note(If you are still out of bounds when you load up the game you will have to make a new save file)
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies from the easter event still spawned.

[*] Fixed duplication glitch.

[*] added a fadeoff to the minimap. 

[*] added the ability to see weapon and armor equipped via the status screen.

[*] added the ability the see the weapon/armors strength in its description.
[/list]

Here is the new Roadmap
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42015587/2ab375cfcf19348c13db8b837d30f896675dc658.png[/img]
Things I'm working on
[list]
[*] Adding health bars to enemies

[*] Adding volume sliders

[/list]

If you want to report bugs you can via the ticket system in the discord https://discord.gg/rkymncz3X5

We also reached 1.2k Unique Players! Thank you to everyone who downloaded the game and i have a lot more coming.

notes.title: Resolution Support and Misc Fixes and Changes
notes.notes:
I've added resolution support for 1920x1080, 1366x768, 2560x1440, and 3840x2160. If you use a resolution not added in this update add a comment saying what res you use so i can add it.

Quality of Life Changes:

Made camera view larger

Added a skip option for beginning cut-scene

Made cursor larger

Changed Easter Event achievement and added gray scale to the achievements not acquired yet.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed Items not saving correctly(requires you to validate files)

Fixed bug were objects in the scene would show up in the main menu

Also as for what will be added next after this update i will be working on the shop and audio settings and i will have more news on these things as they progress. I will still be working on any bugs that get reported.

notes.title: Easter Event!
notes.notes:
The Easter Event just launched and I've added a new enemy for the event. They are harder to encounter than other enemies but you get Easter eggs which you can open for special items and gear, and if your lucky enough you can find a gold version which drops a gold Easter egg which has a higher chance to give you the super rare drop!

Bug Fixes:

Fixed achievements not always working

Fixed Game Over scene not playing the right music

Fixed infinite item use glitch

Added:

added 7 new items for the Easter Event

added two new enemies Egg, Golden Egg

added achievement for the Easter event

notes.title: Nightfall is Released!
notes.notes: Nightfall has just gone live so go check it out! The game is in very early access but i have a lot a features planned and upcoming. The roadmap will be changed as i want to change the release dates of somethings i have planned. I do plan on having bug fixes and small content updates leading up to the release of the next volume/area. The discord is also launched you can join via the link on the store page or this one right here( https://discord.gg/rkymncz3X5 ). If you want to report bugs there is a ticket system in the discord where you can contact me directly and tell me the issue.

notes.title: Regarding The Release Of Nightfall
notes.notes: Due to a bug with Nightfall I will have to delay the launch of the game till April 8th, about one week. This will most likely be the last delay as most aspects of the game are finished in its current state. The trailer will be releasing soon once this bug is fixed, when the game launches i will also be launching a discord server so if u want to talk to other people about the game, get help or even join in on community events come join us!
